quotations.old_english: Nys ríce Godes meta ( esca) and drinc
Æ­gþer ge hrægles ge metes ge drinces
Wermód drincan ǽr þon þe hié mete þicgan
Hú sió womb weorðe mid swótlecustum mettum gefylled

definitions.meaning: a meal, meat as in at meat

quotations.old_english: Þonne hí hira hláf brǽcon æt mete
Æ­lce dæge ǽr mete þrié cucler fulle geþicge

source_text: mete. Add: I. food :-- Gif mete sý áwyrd, Lch. ii. 142, 14. Nys ríce Godes meta ( esca) and d UNCERTAINinc, Scint. 153, 7. Æ-acute;gþer ge hrægles ge metes ge drinces, Bt. 26, 2 ; F. 94, 4. Wið genumenum mete, Lch. ii. 142, 7. Wermód drincan ǽr þon þe hié mete þicgan, 32, 1. Ne reccaþ hí þára metta, Bt. 25 ; F. 88, 19. Hú sió womb weorðe mid swótlecustum mettum gefylled, Past. 311, 9. II. a meal, meat as in at meat :-- Þonne hí hira hláf brǽcon æt mete, Shrn. 30, 8. Æ-acute;lce dæge ǽr mete þrié cucler fulle geþicge, Lch. ii. 152, 7. v. bleó-, fór-, ofer-, searu-, smeá-, sufel-, swét-, swot-, wist-mete.
